ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (25) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Совершенствование» (sovershenstvovanie) and, in the closing thought, «усовершенствование» (usovershenstvovanie) are both 'perfecting', since both concern the moral life; «устройство» (ustroystvo, 'structure') is 'structure'. «Федор Страхов» is 'Fyodor Strakhov' (D0003). The paragraph beginning 'One may take up this too…' is printed after the Strakhov attribution although it answers the line 'Why not organize labor!'; it is translated where it stands.

Source observation: [19] The unquoted paragraph «Можно заняться и этим. Но не надо забывать, что, организуя труд…» stands after the attribution «Федор Страхов.» (block 18), but it answers the quoted line «Отчего не организовать труд!» (block 14) and seems to belong inside the Strakhov passage, between blocks 14 and 15; possibly displaced in print or transcription. Translated where it stands.
